ownership: Only new acceptance test/report and proposal artifacts were written; no production runtime, registry, catalog, canonical mapping, deployment or live infrastructure changes.

findings.title: Detected encoded metadata recurrence persists
findings.impact: Real pinned tools detect a literal GitHub-format synthetic token, but its base64 copy in native Function/Instance description survived plaintext-only redaction and entered returned JSON and Transport cache.
findings.root_fix: Root extended redact_matches once per call to exact plaintext, JSON-escaped text and one standard/URL-safe base64 layer, padded or unpadded; changed facts receive unknown coverage.

findings.title: Selected object/archive item omits metadata read provenance
findings.impact: Both reads appeared in envelope provenance, but the complete scanned item carried only its final media receipt and lacked the native generation/size/permission metadata read.
findings.root_fix: Root attached both native receipt IDs through the marker field coverage, which the actual envelope merges into per-item provenance.

findings.title: Multi-page log sample item omits earlier read provenance
findings.impact: A complete two-page sampled negative included both pages but linked only the final page from the sample item.
findings.root_fix: Root added _coverage.sample source_requests for all contributing page receipts.

findings.title: Ambient netrc overrides selected native bearer
findings.impact: Requests preparation can replace headers Authorization with Basic auth from netrc. The initial injected plain Session reproduced that behavior; root confirmed production _session also originally created a plain Session. The regression was corrected to exercise actual Transport._session and passed after the concurrent root fix.
findings.root_fix: Root native_header_session installs explicit no-op auth to preserve the chosen native bearer without disabling existing proxy/CA environment support. Dedicated new readers retain trust_env=False.

findings.title: GKE workload reference metadata reflects a detected value
findings.impact: A token detected in one Pod literal also used as another env name survived in retained references[].envName. The env name is native-schema-valid; no Secret or token volume was read.
findings.root_fix: GKE owner applied the shared _redact_values/redact_matches callback over the retained projection. The earlier unapplied worker proposal is superseded by that owner fix; regression now verifies no retained reference canary.

findings.title: Dataflow item attributed to another job FULL read
findings.impact: A two-job summary page and two FULL GETs yielded both items against the final GET ID, omitting the first item own FULL receipt and incorrectly associating it with the second job.
findings.root_fix: Unapplied candidate-dataflow-row-provenance.patch proposes list plus per-row FULL refs (including failures) in marker coverage and safe opaque per-get resource_id. Job owner independently fixed equivalent per-row provenance during review.

findings.title: Later-page detection leaves earlier metadata copies
findings.impact: Actual functions.list pagination, Transport cache, envelope and finish retain a first-page native description containing the exact token detected only in the second-page literal environment. Same-page redaction does not revisit prior copies.
findings.root_fix: Root added omit_free_text_metadata before cache for opted-in Functions and selected configuration kinds: recursively omit description/descriptions/labels/annotations with unknown coverage, preserving identities and typed security fields. No run-global raw-value cache. Earlier description-only proposal is superseded. Tests cover historical Function descriptions plus native Run description/labels/annotations and typed fact guards.

test_scope: Actual engine named-check planning and existing secrets finding type for every currently registered declared ID.
Hosted selection shape validation and rejection of forged internal planner kinds.
All seven embedded configuration transport hooks and nine acquisition adapters require opt-in plus named gate; zero added content calls/default detector invocations.
Actual native Transport/cache handling of real dual-detector metadata privacy and cross-service value dedup.
Actual GCPCollector.pages/envelope/finish for multi-page Functions privacy; metadata/media and multi-page log provenance.
Native GCP sensitive-value/execution/external endpoint rejection before auth; denied/redirected log streams closed without parsing provider bodies.
Candidate native GKE Reader and native Dataflow Reader/envelope seams for exact reproducers.

module_review.boundary: Registered after the original bounded acceptance run. Included only in generic named-gate and secrets-group tests in final rerun; native configuration/HTTP/schema behavior remains with root and the owning worker, per coordinator instruction to close bounded review.
Existing raw metadata GET, exact scope/location/name and unmasked params; inspect serviceConfig/buildConfig env maps before normal JSON cache; both complete detectors required.
Exact native GET routes/selfLink/project joins, complete supported literal fields and pre-cache scrub; Secret Manager refs not dereferenced; remote Build filenames remain unknown.
Bounded time-window entries.list, raw stream/JSON projection, three-page/100-entry/byte/time bounds, no Audit protoPayload as application content.
Exact generation + native bucket/CRM binding; isolated bounded raw reader, archive parser in memory, ordinal locations, shared budgets. No directory/object enumeration or filesystem extraction.

Exact selected immutable native image/repository/project, fixed registry host, no redirects/challenge realms; manifest/config/layer digest+size and rootfs diff ID checks, bounded in-memory TAR and constant locations.

Scheduler target body/header/attribute literals; exact masked App Engine FULL env maps after parent list; Workflows deployed source at exact native revision. Dedicated bounded uncached branch, no execution or remote referenced content.

Exact selected native parent and file; repository contents versus workspace fileContents; immutable commit/revision or explicitly observed workspace read. Dedicated bounded uncached JSON/base64/UTF8 stream; no checkout/remote fallback.

Explicit regions, native CRM alias binding, Dataflow full-view GET, supported Batch/Dataproc literal JSON; no job submit, script/image/file/KMS/managed-secret dereference. Candidate at first reproduction; root integrated during review.

Explicit native cluster/namespace selection with native CA/endpoint authority, existing Google token, read-only Pod/ConfigMap endpoints. No Secret, token-volume, exec, logs or mutation calls. Candidate at first reproduction.

proof_limits: No live cloud, credential validation, deployment or whole cloud suite. Current source files can change during root integration; exact before/after hashes are retained and source drift invalidates a settled-source claim.

Native HTTP fixtures exercise real code paths and real pinned Kingfisher 1.4.0/TruffleHog 3.92.5 on synthetic values. They do not prove live IAM grants, service availability, endpoint behavior or adversarial socket timing.

GKE and Dataflow reproducers isolate production reader/projection/envelope seams; their parent inventories/binding context are native-schema fixtures, not live provider authority. Root/owner native integration tests remain necessary after installation.

Function/configuration hooks retain the inherited generic metadata JSON acquisition path; their scan bounds are checked after JSON parsing. This review does not certify a pre-parse whole-response byte bound for that generic metadata transport. Dedicated content readers have explicit byte/call/time/file/page guards.

Redaction closure covers tested exact values and one common textual base64/JSON-escaped layer within scrubbed projections; no claim about arbitrary encryption, nested encodings, every unscanned metadata field, secret-bearing resource identities or independent collections. Conservative omission addresses the demonstrated cross-page free-text boundary only.

No upstream lineage was counted as semantic equivalence, and candidate declarations were not counted as registered checks. All negatives remain limited to returned literal configuration or explicitly selected files/images/log samples.

timeline.note: Two real encoded recurrences, object/archive item receipt omissions, log page omission, and plain-session netrc behavior. Initial full-file pre-fix hashes were not captured before root edits; exact later snapshots and regression evidence are preserved without inventing a historical revision.

timeline.result: Root applied encoding, selected-object/archive, log receipt and explicit-session-auth fixes; actual production regressions retested.
GKE reference reflection and Dataflow per-row FULL receipt bugs reproduced; narrow proposals sent to owners.
Functions two-page metadata reflection reproduced through actual finish/cache. Root notified separately.
